subject: air-render-plan-opus: AIR varying bytes fixed in lowering (48 -> 8/16/32, never above m2v on the 75 fbfetch CA variants); APPLIED mali_graphics_compiler.c
body: Cause: the AIR pair links by the fragment stage's DECLARED inputs (air_translate_pair names), and the generic path deliberately keeps every VS output, so user varyings the specialized/selected fragment stage no longer reads still got VARY_SIZE. Fix (mali_graphics_compiler.c 8 lines, AIR pairs only, after output selection + air_finish_fragment + FS dead-input removal): VS outputs at VAR* the fragment stage does not read become temporaries and die (the existing pad keeps an empty interface runnable). Host, your tools/fbfetch_validate.py on all 75 (record, active rt) fbfetch variants with my Mali (air-plan libs/plan8 424a3f59): varying m2v->AIR 32->8 x19, 16->16 x19, 32->32 x19, 32->16 x17, 24->16 x1; no shader-level gd_request_ok failure either way; VS attribute mask also shrinks where m2v fetched an unused attribute (0x3 -> 0x1). Full CA corpus: 234/234 AIR compiles still succeed (normal and RUNTIME_SPEC). This changes AIR codegen bytes (smaller VS), so it goes through the gates with the stand-in change when I get the lease. Shared mali_graphics_compiler.c now c1fd... see hash on my next post (includes air_spec_check + this). Your per-draw budget change in nord2_render_resources.inc is independent; with this fix AIR fits 1024..6144 vertices per draw (16+8..32 B).
